description: Fixed DurationAttributeConverter negative fractional duration serialization and parsing. Values like Duration.ofMillis(-1) now serialize as -0.001000000 and round trip correctly. Previously stored values are not corrected, and older SDK versions will read negative sub-second values written by this version with the wrong sign. Fixes [#7060](https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-java-v2/issues/7060).
